text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, January 23, 2018 Posted by admin on January 23rd, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Cisco (CSCO), Goldman Sachs (GS), Home Depot (HD), JPMorgan (JPM), Coca Cola (KO), McDonald’s (MCD), Microsoft (MSFT), Travelers (TRV), Visa (V), Wal-Mart (WMT) and Exxon Mobil (XOM). Dow stock 52 week lows include General Electric (GE). 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +3 points. 
Monday the Dow was up +142.88 (+0.55%) at 26214.60. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +6.05%. 
There were 23 Dow stocks up Monday. 
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Verizon (VZ) +2.99% and Goldman Sachs (GS) +2.11%. 
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Nike (NKE) -1.22% and Apple (APPL) -0.82%. 
Caterpillar (CAT +0.28%) was upgraded to ‘Buy’ from ‘Neutral’ at Seaport Global with a price target of $195. 
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is up five-tenths of a cent at $2.543 per gallon.
